minutes.headline: Zoning board continued the used-car license hearing for Whalen Sales and Service to July 24 at eight o'clock.
minutes.summary: The board heard a continued application from Edward Oliver to renew a class 2 used-car license and repair license at 93 Whalen Road. Members said the lot was not yet ready, with junk piles and equipment still on it and the Board of Health's final inspection pending. A motion to continue to July 24 was made and seconded, and the time was set at eight o'clock.

public_comment.topic: Abutter across the street worried about heavy equipment, winter snow clearing and vehicles clogging the road; submitted photos of the yard.

decisions.decision: Public discussion closed and the board returned to deliberation.
The continued hearing was set for July 24th at eight o'clock, a time certain after another hearing.
Applicant told the next hearing will not be continued again and must show the property cleaned up as it really is.
Applicant asked to put in writing his wintertime use plans for the property.

what_happened.line: The Zoning Board of Appeals continued the Whalen Sales and Service used-car and repair license renewal hearing to July 24 at eight o'clock.
A motion to continue was made and seconded; the vote was not audible in the recording.
Members said the lot was not ready, with junk and equipment still on it and the Board of Health's final inspection pending.
The applicant was told the next hearing will not be continued again and must show the property cleaned up as it really is.
The applicant was asked to put his wintertime use plans for the property in writing.
